verses.text: And you, O tower of the flock, O hill of the daughter of Zion, To you will it come, Indeed the first dominion will come, The kingdom to the daughter of Jerusalem.
Why do you now cry out aloud? Is there no king among you? Has your counselor perished, That pain has seized you like a woman delivering a child?

verses.text: But they do not know The thoughts of Jehovah, And they do not understand His counsel; For He has gathered them like sheaves for the threshing floor.
